claims.statement: Aspiration to reach INR10,000 crore+ revenue with EBITDA margins above 20% by FY2031 under Project Ahvaan

Projects under implementation: 200 TPD caustic soda flaking at Dahej (target Dec 2026), 120 TPD HCl synthesis (target Jan 2027), Chlorotoluene downstream Phase 1 (by Mar 2027), electronic-grade hydrogen peroxide (Jan 2028), KOH expansion Va

Overall plant utilization ~92%; Chlorotoluene plant utilization ramped to ~90% from inauguration last year; grid disturbances and shutdowns kept overall utilization marginally lower than previous year
Chlorine integration currently ~45% (pipeline sales ~150 TPD, merchant sales ~700-750 TPD); target to reach ~75% integration in next 2-3 years via HCl synthesis units and phosphoric acid plant
H1 FY27 actual power mix: 43% DISCOM+GNAL (81 MW), 28% short-term RE (52 MW), 29% own wind (53 MW); target to commission long-term captive RE SPVs to reduce grid dependence
